title: Pierce BCA Protein Assay Protocol
author: Rita Chen
materials: This is a slightly modified version of the Pierce™ BCA Protein Assay (ThermoFisher Scientific). Figure 1: Graphical depiction of procedure summary, from ThermoScientific

steps.title: Calculate Reagent Volumes
steps.instruction: Use the BCA Protein Assay Calculation Template Excel spreadsheet to determine the total volume of Working Reagent (WR) and the required volumes of Reagent A and Reagent B to achieve a 20:1 concentration ratio.

substeps.instruction: Enter the number of unknown samples in cell B6.

steps.title: Prepare BSA Protein Standards
steps.instruction: Prepare nine standards in 2 mL tubes with a working range of 25-2,000 µg/mL according to the following dilution table:

substeps.instruction: Vial A: 0 µL diluent, 300 µL stock (2,000 µg/mL)
Vial B: 125 µL diluent, 375 µL stock (1,500 µg/mL)
Vial C: 325 µL diluent, 325 µL stock (1,000 µg/mL)
Vial D: 175 µL diluent, 175 µL of vial B (750 µg/mL)
Vial E: 325 µL diluent, 325 µL of vial C (500 µg/mL)
Vial F: 325 µL diluent, 325 µL of vial E (250 µg/mL)
Vial G: 325 µL diluent, 325 µL of vial F (125 µg/mL)
Vial H: 400 µL diluent, 100 µL of vial G (25 µg/mL)
Vial I: 400 µL diluent, 0 µL BSA (Blank)

steps.title: Load Microplate
steps.instruction: Prepare the microplate to create a 1:8 ratio of sample:WR.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of prepared WR to each well.
Add 25 µL of each sample in triplicate.
Pipette 10X per well to mix (final volume 225 µL).

steps.title: Incubate Plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate to develop the color reaction.

substeps.instruction: Cover the plate with a semi-permeable seal.
Incubate at 37 °C static for 00:30:00.
With the seal on, cool the plate to Room temperature for 00:10:00.

steps.title: Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Quantify the protein concentration using a microplate reader.

substeps.instruction: Remove the seal and dispose of it in biohazard waste.
Measure absorbance at 562 nm on the BioTek Synergy H1 microplate reader (wavelengths 540–590 nm are acceptable).

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Input absorbance data into the BCA Protein Assay Calculations Template to normalize data against blanks and perform linear regression to determine unknown concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Add more unknown rows or replicate columns to the spreadsheet if necessary.

steps.title: Cleanup and Storage
steps.instruction: Dispose of waste and store reagents at designated temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Empty benchtop sharps container into larger floor sharps container.
Dispose of the 96w assay plate in the biohazard waste bin.
Store BCA Assay Reagent A, Reagent B, and BSA Protein Standards at 15-30 °C (BSA standards at 4 °C if previously opened).
